specialAttack.name: Rage
specialAttack.description: trance: +4 morale bonus to Con, +2 morale bonus on Reflex and Will saves (+6/+3 at greater rage, +8/+4 at mighty rage), no penalty to AC, Dex-, Int- and Cha-based skills usable

Trance.descriptionOnly: it may be of a lawful alignment while neutral in its other part, told here

Spirit Conduit.descriptionOnly: no path: each totem rage power is a class option the player picks as the trance begins
